messages:
maria: Heads-up — FinCo's security team just emailed a SOC2 auditor request. They want full SBOM for our Node + Python SDKs, dependency CVE status, KMS usage/audit logs, and a remediation ETA. They asked for a timeline by EOD Friday. Looping in @jake @elaine to help triage.

security-bot: Automated vuln scan for commit abc123 (main) finished. Summary: 2 high, 3 medium, several low. Top hits: CVE-2024-1452 (high) - proto-parser, CVE-2023-3321 (high) - openssl-bindings. Full report: https://ci.redwood-internal/reports/vuln/abc123 
```
- CVE-2024-1452 proto-parser RCE (used in sdk-build)
- CVE-2023-3321 openssl-bindings arbitrary code (transitive)
- CVE-2022-9910 http-client medium
```

jake: @maria copying what I need — which SDK versions are in scope? I can run a lockfile audit and prepare SBOMs. Quick checks: run `npm audit --json` for node and `pip-audit -f json` or `python -m pip freeze` + syft.

maria: FinCo listed these in their email: node-sdk@1.3.0, python-sdk@2.0.1. They also want evidence of KMS key rotation for service keys used by our private deployment customers.

elaine: For prioritization — the proto-parser RCE is scary if it's reachable from CI/build steps. @jake can you confirm whether proto-parser is only a dev dependency or bundled in published SDKs? If it's only in dev, mitigation is easier (CI lockdown + rotate build agent keys).

jake: Quick grep shows proto-parser is imported in `sdk/build-tools` and also still referenced in `sdk/dist/packager` (oops). That means it's in build artifacts for node-sdk. Treat as high. I'll push patch to remove runtime import or replace parser in the next patch.

ross: On KMS logs: cloud KMS audit logs are retained 90 days in project-level audit. We can export to BigQuery for archival. If FinCo needs rotation proof older than 90d we'll need to export logs now. I can start the export job; it takes ~2 hours to populate recent logs.

maria: Good — auditor asked for the SBOM file path and a record that keys used for the node-sdk signing key rotated Jan 2026 (proof of rotation and KMS request IDs). @ross can you include the request IDs in the exported logs?

ross: Yep, I'll include key operation logs and the rotation request IDs. I'll put export under gs://redwood-evidence/FinCo/2026-03-20/ and set perms to FinCo-auditors@finco.com read-only.

elaine: Proposed remediation order and ETA: 
1) Critical (proto-parser RCE) — remove runtime usage, publish patched node-sdk 1.3.1 to npm. Target: tomorrow EOD (2026-03-21 18:00 PDT).
2) Critical (openssl-bindings) — bump transitive dep and rebuild wheels for python-sdk; target: staging deploy 2026-03-23, production 2026-03-24.
3) Mediums — schedule dependency updates in scheduled maintenance window (next week).

jake: Workplan notes: 
- Generate SBOMs with syft: `syft packages ./sdk/node -o json > sbom-node-1.3.1.json` and `syft packages ./sdk/python -o json > sbom-python-2.0.1.json`
- Local commands to confirm: `npm ls proto-parser` and `pip-audit --full-report`.
- I'll attach SBOMs to `SOC2_EVIDENCE/FinCo/2026-03-20/` once generated.

security-bot: CI quickfix: branch fix/proto-parser-avoid created; build triggered. Current status: build 1245 running, dependency update applied to lockfile.

maria: Action items: @jake - produce SBOMs + publish patched node-sdk and upload SBOMs; @ross - export KMS logs + include rotation request IDs; @elaine - prepare brief remediation timeline doc for auditor (one-pager with steps + test plan). I'll draft the reply to FinCo and ask for an extension to EOD Monday if needed. :eyes:

jake: ACK — working on SBOMs now. If CI passes I'll cut 1.3.1 and notify publishing team.

ross: Export job started. ETA for first export file: ~2h. I'll DM the request IDs when available.

elaine: Draft remediation doc path: `SOC2_EVIDENCE/FinCo/2026-03-20/remediation-plan.md` — will include regression test checklist and rollout gating. Will attach screenshots of KMS audit view.

maria: I'll send an interim reply now with the immediate mitigations and ETA. Final evidence bundle will include: sbom-node-1.3.1.json, sbom-python-2.0.1.json, kms-export-2026-03-20.json, remediation-plan.md.

ross: Uploaded first chunk to gs://redwood-evidence/FinCo/2026-03-20/kms-export-part1.json (internal link). DMing the auditor link and access perms.

jake: Published node-sdk@1.3.1 to npm (tag: patch). SBOMs generated and uploaded. `npm publish` log:
```
> node-sdk@1.3.1 published
> removed proto-parser import in packager
```

elaine: :+1: I'll include the publish logs and a short note showing the `package.json` bump and SHA of the published tarball in the evidence bundle.

maria: Thanks team — I'll send the auditor the interim response and attach the evidence we have so far. We'll follow up if they request anything deeper. :thumbsup:
